answer: See the agent economy as an ocean where every newcomer docks at a wharf and answers a beacon changing every 90 seconds. First, the wharf broadcasts a challenge tied to market data. Second, each identity signs it within 90 seconds with its key. Third, late or copied signatures are rejected and it is quarantined. Fourth, three strikes burn its bond. Forging 10,000 fakes means answering 10,000 at once, needing 400 servers at $320,000 a month and 12 engineers on shifts, and one slip starts a spiral of bans wiping the whole fleet. Like a lighthouse guiding only ships truly there. - Jowy
